description: Product lookups record channel labels and returned product codes for Cigo's usage analytics. Reuse the returned journey_token only within this customer's current conversation when calling another product lookup or submit_b2b_inquiry. Never invent a token or reuse one for a different customer. If unavailable, omit it. Do not display the token in sales replies. Save a customer-confirmed quote, sample or supply-feasibility inquiry (not an order). Accept B2B inquiries from any country in the customer's language for HVAC/cleanroom filters, nanofiber materials, waterproof/breathable textiles, cosmetic applications and other uses. Ask for company, contact email, destination country, subject and details; preserve original text and pass the customer's language code. Before submitting, show the inquiry and obtain confirmation. Explain that Cigo stores the original and, when enabled, sends the subject and details to Microsoft Azure Translator for Korean machine translation. Do not send passwords or payment data. Inquiry acceptance does not establish overseas sales or shipping availability. Supply feasibility, price, certification and delivery are subject to staff review. 전 세계 B2B 문의 접수: 공조·클린룸 필터, 나노섬유 원단 및 다양한 응용 소재.
